$\sum_{i = 1}^{a} \sum_{j = 1}^{b} \sum_{k = 1}^{c} d(i \cdot j \cdot k)$

-----Input-----

-----Output-----

import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def precompute_divisors(max_value):
    divisors_count = [0] * (max_value + 1)
    for i in range(1, max_value + 1):
        for j in range(i, max_value + 1, i):
            divisors_count[j] += 1
    return divisors_count

def main():
    data = input().split()
    a = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    c = int(data[2])
    
    max_value = a * b * c
    divisors_count = precompute_divisors(max_value)

    MOD = 1073741824

        for j in range(1, b + 1):
            for k in range(1, c + 1):
                product = i * j * k
                total_sum += divisors_count[product]
    
    print(total_sum % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
